Info

Defines pure ControlWaypointDescriptor data model encapsulating control waypoint construction parameters.

class scaralang.core.model.dsl.compiler.control_waypoint_descriptor.ControlWaypointDescriptor(*, name: str, command: str, phi: float, speed: float)[source]¶

Bases: object

Pure immutable data model encapsulating parameters for building a control command waypoint.

It defines:

attributes:
name - Symbolic waypoint name.
command - Command string token.
phi - Tool orientation rotation angle in degrees.
speed - Motion feedrate speed in mm/s.
